answer: Co-located workload attestation.** Each identity must submit a signed sonnet of hardware telemetry: CPU serial, RAM timing fingerprints, and NIC queue jitter, hashed jointly. A validator challenges the agent to recompute a fresh hash under timing constraints. Duplicates on one machine produce correlated fingerprints, flagged instantly. The nebula of distinct machines is the scarce resource; cloning identities needs distinct physical hosts. An attacker renting an ocean of cloud VMs pays full hardware cost per identity, roughly $200/month, with no bulk discount.
